notes.title: 🎯 THANK YOU! +1,000 PLAYERS
notes.content:
🎯 THANK YOU! +1,000 PLAYERS
SOULHOT has officially reached over 1,000 players in just 24 hours during Steam Next Fest — and we couldn't be more grateful. This milestone means everything to us as an indie team crafting a bold, time-bending shooter with a unique identity.

🚨 In SOULHOT, time only moves when you move — and clearly, you moved fast.

The battlefield is filled with shattered glass, slow-motion bullets, and cinematic tension… and you're at the center of it all. From the moment you stepped into the demo, you helped shape the momentum behind this project.

Your support fuels our motivation to push further, polish harder, and deliver something unforgettable.

🎮 If you haven’t played yet — what are you waiting for?
Download the free demo and join the growing wave of players bending time and rewriting action.

📝 And if you believe in SOULHOT, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist — it makes a huge difference for launch visibility and future updates.
[hr][/hr]🔧 Demo Feedback Update
Thanks to your feedback, we’ve already spotted a few issues:

VSync was accidentally left enabled by default

The back/exit button on the elevator screen doesn’t work

These are now on our radar and will be fixed in our upcoming weekly update.

📣 Please share any bugs, suggestions, or compliments on our Steam forums —
we’re listening: Steam Discussions Steam Discussion→
[hr][/hr]
With gratitude,
ZEKA GAMES

notes.title: Soulhot – WEEKLY UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello SOULshooters,

This week marks a major milestone in the development of Soulhot. We’ve officially completed and implemented six unique weapons, each fully functional and ready for action. These weapons are designed to support a variety of playstyles — from precise long-range takedowns to up-close, explosive encounters.

✅ Completed Weapons:

Minigun – Extremely high fire rate with suppressive power. Ideal for players who want to dominate the battlefield with relentless pressure. Best used for area control, pinning enemies down, or breaking through defenses with overwhelming force.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/7d34085e85d0b8f5a5cee9aa70aadef3a28874c7.png

Sawed-off Shotgun – Devastating in close quarters. Ideal for aggressive, fast-entry tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/40387fcf85442a3e4acead596bca68765a070e8e.png

Tactical SMG P90 – Rapid-fire with high mobility. Great for players who prefer constant movement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/e162ae3b4a0b6e08169b289773f5e2983454044c.png

Silenced Pistol – Quiet and deadly. Enables stealthy eliminations with minimal noise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/7128068a5deb92e5659016fddf7f0f1e98e2a7bc.png

Dual Silenced Pistols – Silent but deadly in rapid succession. Ideal for agile players who thrive on speed, flanking, and stylish eliminations. These lightweight sidearms deliver precise bursts without revealing your position — perfect for hit-and-run tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/046ea3d01637ad87b29e4870f48cc95478f0c969.png

Scoped Rifle – Long-range precision. A must-have for snipers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/ececc7d9f948a1ac7ef323ec69bf29df7280884f.png

Custom AR Kit – A modular weapon built for versatility. Balanced performance at medium range, customizable attachments coming soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/404134fbcbbffa88cb3112ef95fdb7fc2678d98e.png

Each weapon is enhanced with cinematic feedback and physics-based interactions — including glass shattering, metal spark deflections, and bullet ricochet effects — all designed to deliver a John Wick-inspired kinetic combat experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811218/2b5ecce930839039bd8ebef16a33f4999d17194c.gif

🔧 What’s Next:
Begin building out the weapon customization system

Prototype armor and attachment variations

Introduce and test new enemy types — including aggressive, shark-like AI opponents that patrol and respond to player movement dynamically

As we continue shaping Soulhot, your feedback is invaluable. Let us know what kind of weapons, features, or mechanics you would love to see in the game.

Stay sharp, and see you in the next update.
Published by ZEKA GAMES | www.zekagames.com
